about: Reviewed joins and paraphrases for the harness atlas. Facts a catalog holds (winners, states, pins, slot statuses, model and effort values, counts) are never copied in; tools/local-pages/atlas_data.py reads them at build time. Every cites[] item names a repository path, a line and an anchor phrase that line contains, and a test opens each one. Standing rules are paraphrases; none quotes owner chat.

definitions.text: The vendor's maintained agent client running a model with every layer its role needs: skills and instructions, MCP tools, hooks, memory and token efficiency, telemetry, isolation and roles, and receipts. Tools are scoped to the role and never stripped. A bare API call serves only as a measurement probe, recorded as such.
